## TQQQ Read
- Momentum: **Neutral, close to oversold** (RSI 31.3, 1.3 points above 30). A fresh 8.06% flush after 3 red days is the kind of move that often pushes RSI under 30 on the next down day. The stabilizing-after-a-flush setup is **not** present yet, because no green day has appeared. Premium is not rich against realized movement.
- Market structure: **DOWNTURN.** Spot is 27.8% under the $73.43 4-week high ($53.03 / $73.43 = 0.722), past the 20% line. VXN is 32.90, past the 25 line. Both legs are met, and by a wide margin now. Spot is 5.5% above the 4-week low ($53.03 / $50.25 = 1.055), far short of the 30% line for RALLY. The label is no longer fragile: a flip back to SIDEWAYS needs a close above about $58.74, which is 10.8% above spot.
- Trend: below the 50DMA by 24.82% and below the 200DMA by 19.1%. Spot is 39.54% under the 52-week high and 42.7% above the 52-week low.
- Volatility & premium environment: VXN is 32.90, up 11.98% in one day. Chain ATM IV is 0.77 and IV/HV is 0.73 (HV20 105.6%). IV/HV under 1 means options cost less than the stock has actually been moving, so sellers get no extra cushion. Premium is large in dollars, but swings are larger. Chain IV of 77% is about 22% under the ~99% implied by the 3x-VXN rule of thumb, which is itself only an estimate. VVIX at 114.23 (+12.51%) says the volatility itself is unstable.
- Put-selling context: HOSTILE. The stage is 5, six of seven lenses are bearish, spot is under both moving averages, TQQQ fell 8.06% in one day, and the VIX curve has tipped into slight backwardation. IV/HV of 0.73 means premium is cheap relative to realized movement. Spot sits 5.2% above the 4-week low, so a break of that level would put the price in territory not seen in this window. Credit inside both lines is the one softening sign, and it is thin (HY 0.02 points under). A TQQQ close above the 200DMA near $65.55 with VIX back under 20 would be the first real change. Context only — no strikes, expiries or sizes.
